title: Research
purpose: Establish a truthful, source-grounded understanding of the problem, context, people, domain, existing state, risks, constraints, and unknowns before those unknowns are converted into architecture or code. Research is not a ceremonial opening phase and is not limited to web searching.
why_it_matters: A coding agent can produce plausible implementation faster than a human can notice that the wrong problem was framed. Once an unsupported assumption becomes architecture, every downstream artifact may become internally consistent and still be wrong.
applies_when: Research applies whenever the work depends on facts, needs, behavior, constraints, environments, technology, law, risk, feasibility, prior art, user experience, market conditions, physical conditions, or source state that are not already adequately established.

Depth is proportional to consequence, novelty, uncertainty, disagreement, cost, and reversibility. A small reversible script may need a brief source and requirement check. A production system, safety-critical device, governance mechanism, AI system, public product, or irreversible change requires deeper and independently challenged research.
does_not_apply_when: Research may be minimal when all material inputs are already authoritative, current, directly supplied, internally consistent, and sufficient for the declared low-consequence scope.
A non-applicability determination must still identify:
prerequisites: Research begins from:
an attributable human objective;
a declared initial scope or question;
required_inputs: The human's actual objective and desired outcome.
Known users, owners, operators, stakeholders, affected communities, and decision owners.
Existing documents, repositories, systems, products, workflows, interfaces, datasets, environments, logs, incidents, and continuity records.
human_authority: The human: - defines or confirms the objective; - identifies values, priorities, unacceptable harms, protected information, and practical constraints; - authorizes access to private or controlled sources; - corrects mischaracterized needs, context, and lived experience; - decides material value conflicts and accepts risk where acceptance cannot be delegated;
ai_boundary: The AI: - records the objective without silent substitution; - inspects supplied source material and current state before proposing conclusions; - creates a research plan proportional to consequence and uncertainty; - separates observations, source claims, inferences, assumptions, recommendations, and unknowns; - identifies source identity, version, provenance, freshness, scope, and limitations;
specialist_expertise_cues_not_authority: reports source-grounded information within the accepted question
evidence_requirements: A material research claim should point to one or more of:
supplied source text or artifact location;
failure_anti_patterns: Objective substitution: researching a more familiar problem than the human asked about.
Confirmation bias: collecting only evidence supporting the first idea.
Source laundering: repeating a claim across many derivative sources and presenting repetition as independent support.
recovery: When research is incomplete or unreliable:
quarantine affected conclusions from downstream use;
identify which requirements, architecture decisions, or implementation tasks are contaminated;
completion: Section 001 is complete for a declared research scope only when:
the objective and questions are explicit;
material sources are identified and bounded;
source_gaps: This draft applies the supplied requirements for objective preservation, unknown-means-unknown, evidence before claims, current-state inspection, continuity, hostile review, bounded roles, source identity, owner research, owner journeys, human authority, delegation, proof-carrying work, and prerequisite-aware resolution.

This section has been cross-linked with drafted Sections 012, 015, 016, and 017 at the first integration checkpoint. It must later receive full source reconciliation with those sections and with Sections 163, 164, 165, 208, 256, 257, and 369 as the remaining lifecycle coverage is authored.

Recognize a near-match where it should not govern.
Assign bounded roles without converting expertise into authority.
Determine what evidence/state is sufficient for the next transition and when to defer/suspend/request evidence.

title: Foresight / Futures
purpose: Establish a governed method for examining how the conditions surrounding an objective may change over time, so that present decisions do not depend upon one assumed future or quietly transfer avoidable risk to future users, operators, owners, communities, intelligent systems, or environments. Foresight is not prediction, prophecy, trend theater, or permission to invent certainty.
why_it_matters: Systems are often designed around an invisible sentence: "the world will continue to work like this." That sentence may hide assumptions about users, institutions, laws, infrastructure, economics, climate, security, supply chains, platforms, models, interfaces, ownership, social acceptance, or the capabilities and roles of future AI systems.
applies_when: Foresight applies when one or more of the following are material:
the system or decision is expected to persist, scale, or be inherited;
does_not_apply_when: Foresight may be minimal when the work is short-lived, low-consequence, fully reversible, narrowly bounded, and independent of material external change.
A minimal or non-applicability determination must still record:
prerequisites: Foresight begins from:
Section 001 — Research, including the accepted objective, current-state evidence, assumptions, unknowns, and source register;
an identifiable human decision owner;
required_inputs: The accepted objective and present decision question.
Current-state research and authoritative source material.
Expected product, system, service, data, hardware, or governance lifetime.
human_authority: The human: - defines the purpose of the foresight work and the decision it will support; - selects or confirms the relevant time horizons; - supplies values, protected interests, unacceptable harms, and strategic priorities; - identifies whose future interests must be considered; - determines which tradeoffs are matters of human values rather than technical optimization;
ai_boundary: The AI: - preserves the accepted objective and does not replace it with a preferred future; - distinguishes evidence, extrapolation, scenario assumption, speculation, aspiration, warning, and recommendation; - uses multiple plausible futures rather than presenting one scenario as inevitable; - identifies the time sensitivity, provenance, and limits of forecasts and signals;
evidence_requirements: Material foresight statements should identify whether they are supported by:
current measured or observed conditions;
failure_anti_patterns: Prediction theater: presenting narrative confidence as evidence.
Single-future collapse: treating one forecast as the only future worth designing for.
Trend extrapolation without limits: extending recent movement indefinitely while ignoring saturation, reversal, discontinuity, or context.
recovery: When foresight work becomes stale, misleading, or invalid:
mark affected scenarios, recommendations, and dependent decisions as stale or under review;
identify which assumptions, signals, horizons, or authorities changed;
completion: Section 002 is complete for a declared foresight scope only when:
the decision and time horizons are explicit;
the current baseline is source-grounded;
source_gaps: This draft applies the supplied requirements for objective preservation, unknown-means-unknown, evidence before claims, source identity and freshness, bounded roles, human authority, decision support without decision seizure, trust calibration, uncertainty disclosure, alternative analysis, sensitivity analysis, reversibility, points of no return, dissent preservation, expected information gain, staged experiments, rollback, recovery, continuity, owner visibility, and trusted advancement that cannot outrun evidence or authority.

The existing role corpus specifically supplies requirements to consider short- and long-term effects, alternative explanations, scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis, minimum-regret analysis, reversible experiments, residual uncertainty, review triggers, and evidence that would change a recommendation. The Owner's Cockpit material supplies requirements for calibrated trust, visible evidence and alternatives, bounded delegation, grounded dialogue, current data, human correction, and accountable action. The V4 design material supplies assumptions, unknowns, obligation lattices, resolution experiments, reversal conditions, dissent, rollback, and trusted-transition concepts.

title: Innovation
purpose: Convert a meaningful unmet need, newly available capability, or changed condition into a bounded, testable opportunity without confusing novelty, idea volume, or technical possibility with legitimate value. Innovation in Thirsty's Codex is governed exploration. It creates room for imagination while preserving objective fidelity, human authority, evidence, reversibility, safety, and continuity.
why_it_matters: Generative systems can produce an enormous number of plausible ideas faster than those ideas can be evaluated. That abundance creates a new failure mode: novelty theater, where fluent possibility is mistaken for usefulness, originality, feasibility, or permission. Governed innovation protects creativity from both premature rejection and premature implementation.
applies_when: A problem remains materially unsolved or existing solutions fail important users, environments, or constraints.
A new technology, model, material, method, dataset, interface, or organizational capability may change what is feasible.
does_not_apply_when: The required change is already understood and belongs to maintenance, implementation, or remediation.
The objective is merely to imitate a known solution without a distinct problem or constraint.
prerequisites: Section 001 Research sufficient to establish the actual problem and current state.
Section 002 Foresight / Futures where long-horizon consequences, path dependence, or emerging capabilities matter.
An authorized human objective, experiment boundary, protected assets, prohibited actions, and final decision owner.
required_inputs: Problem statements, user or owner evidence, current workflows, failure reports, and unmet outcomes.
Relevant technical, scientific, market, operational, legal, ethical, accessibility, and environmental constraints.
Existing alternatives, prior experiments, patents or licenses where applicable, and reasons prior approaches failed.
human_authority: The authorized human defines why exploration is legitimate and retains authority over value, consequence, adoption, and risk. - Confirm the need, intended beneficiaries, values, non-negotiable constraints, and acceptable experiment exposure. - Authorize selection criteria and decide material tradeoffs that depend on values or mission.
ai_boundary: The AI may expand the option space and reduce uncertainty, but it may not manufacture novelty, authority, demand, consent, or success. - Preserve the human's problem and constraints before proposing solutions. - Generate materially different options rather than superficial variations of one favored design. - Identify which ideas are derived from supplied sources, common patterns, inference, or speculative synthesis.
evidence_requirements: Traceable evidence that the problem or opportunity exists within the declared population and context.
Source identity, version, date, and limitations for prior-art and technical claims.
failure_anti_patterns: Solutionism: selecting a technology before establishing the problem.
Innovation theater: rewarding activity, novelty language, demos, or idea counts without decision-relevant evidence.
Prototype laundering: presenting mocked or simulated behavior as implemented capability.
recovery: Innovation must be recoverable from failed hypotheses, unsafe experiments, invalid evidence, and premature adoption.
Stop the affected experiment while preserving logs, artifacts, state, participant protections, and evidence.
Return systems and data to the declared baseline or an explicitly approved safe state.
completion: The opportunity and intended outcome are explicit and evidence-grounded.
Multiple materially different options and the no-action option were considered where applicable.
Assumptions, unknowns, constraints, risks, and affected parties remain visible.
source_gaps: This draft applies the supplied requirements for objective fidelity, source identity, unknown-means-unknown, evidence before claims, bounded roles, human authority, adaptive reasoning depth, minimum-resolution experiments, failure hypotheses, hostile review, dissent preservation, rollback, continuity, and trusted transition. The existing role corpus supplies the Researcher, Analyst, Architect, Planner, Observer, User Experience Reviewer, challenge, governance, and advisory decision functions. The Owner's Cockpit material supplies owner jobs, complete journeys, trust calibration, visible limitations, bounded delegation, grounded action, recovery, and evidence-backed status. The V4 draft supplies claim graphs, obligation lattices, expected information gain, proof-carrying work products, and reversal conditions.

This section therefore integrates the governing source obligations with general innovation practice and must later be reconciled with Feasibility Analysis, Risk Management, Requirements Engineering, Experimentation, intellectual-property, safety, and lifecycle-governance sections.

title: Mission Strategy
purpose: Define the durable purpose, intended beneficiaries, protected values, non-goals, decision principles, and boundaries that should govern all downstream strategy and implementation. Mission strategy converts aspiration into an inspectable direction without pretending that a slogan is an executable plan.
why_it_matters: Without a durable mission boundary, optimization tends to follow whatever metric, technology, funding pressure, or model output is easiest to maximize. Systems can become efficient at work that no longer serves the intended purpose.
applies_when: A product, program, organization, platform, research effort, or long-lived system needs a durable direction.
Multiple initiatives or agents must make consistent decisions under changing conditions.
does_not_apply_when: A small bounded task inherits an already ratified mission and creates no material mission interpretation.
The human has not authorized mission definition or amendment.
prerequisites: Section 001 Research and, where consequence or horizon warrants, Section 002 Foresight / Futures.
An authenticated mission owner and explicit authority to create or amend the mission.
Known stakeholders, beneficiaries, affected parties, protected values, and major constraints.
required_inputs: Founding intent, owner statements, existing mission or constitutional documents, and prior decisions.
Evidence of the problem or opportunity the mission addresses.
Stakeholder, user, domain, legal, ethical, safety, accessibility, and environmental findings.
human_authority: Mission legitimacy and value judgments remain human responsibilities unless a lawful and explicit governance structure says otherwise. - State or ratify the mission, beneficiaries, protected values, and unacceptable harms. - Resolve value conflicts that cannot be settled by factual evidence alone. - Authorize decision principles, success measures, and amendment procedures.
ai_boundary: The AI supports articulation, coherence analysis, scenario testing, traceability, and drift detection. It does not originate sovereign purpose. - Preserve the human's words and distinguish direct statements from interpretation. - Identify contradictions, hidden obligations, omitted affected parties, and metrics that could corrupt the mission.
evidence_requirements: Source records for founding intent and each material interpretation.
Evidence that named beneficiaries, affected parties, and problem conditions are real and current.
failure_anti_patterns: Mission as slogan with no decisions, invariants, evidence, or consequences.
Mission washing: using moral language to legitimize unrelated commercial or technical goals.
Metric capture or Goodhart-style optimization that harms the intended outcome.
recovery: Mission recovery restores legitimate direction after drift, contradiction, harmful interpretation, or invalid authority.
Pause affected consequential work while preserving evidence and safe unaffected operations.
Identify the first decision where mission interpretation diverged from the ratified source.
completion: The mission, beneficiaries, affected parties, values, non-goals, and authority are explicit.
The theory of change and outcome measures expose assumptions and anti-metrics.
Material value conflicts and dissent are visible and assigned to a legitimate decision owner.
source_gaps: This draft applies the supplied requirements for authenticated objectives, scope and authority conservation, human final authority, decision support without decision seizure, dissent conservation, uncertainty preservation, bounded delegation, evidence-backed status, traceability, hostile review, continuity, and trusted transition. It also applies the Owner's Cockpit emphasis on owner jobs, understandable language, visible limitations, real control, recovery, and proof behind every promise.

This section therefore requires those questions to remain explicit human-governance matters and must later be reconciled with ethics, policy, legal, AI safety, AI governance, trust and safety, and lifecycle-governance sections.

Recognize a near-match where it should not govern.

title: Business Strategy
purpose: Translate the ratified mission and evidenced opportunity into a coherent set of choices about where to participate, whom to serve, how value will be created and sustained, which capabilities and partnerships are required, what will not be pursued, and how the organization will remain viable without violating mission or governance boundaries.
why_it_matters: A technically compelling system can fail because its operating model, costs, incentives, channels, obligations, or dependencies were never made real. The reverse is also dangerous: a financially attractive plan can pressure the product and architecture to violate the mission, exploit users, weaken safety, or hide externalities.
applies_when: The work must choose markets, customer groups, channels, partnerships, funding, pricing, or operating models.
A mission or product requires sustainable resources beyond a one-time build.
does_not_apply_when: A bounded internal task inherits an approved business strategy and creates no material strategic choice.
The authorized owner has requested only factual analysis, not strategy selection.
prerequisites: Ratified mission direction and protected invariants from Section 004.
Research, foresight, market, competitive, stakeholder, user, and domain evidence proportional to consequence.
An authorized strategy owner and explicit decision criteria.
required_inputs: Mission, outcomes, customer or beneficiary evidence, and unmet needs.
Market structure, alternatives, competitors, substitutes, pricing or funding evidence, and channel conditions.
Current capabilities, assets, intellectual property, workforce, technology, data, partners, and constraints.
human_authority: The human strategy owner chooses commitments, acceptable tradeoffs, resource allocation, and risk. AI analysis remains advisory unless a narrower authority is explicitly delegated. - Define strategic priorities, mandatory constraints, acceptable economic risk, and protected stakeholders. - Authorize criteria and weighting rather than allowing an AI to infer priorities from available data.
ai_boundary: The AI may structure evidence, compare options, model scenarios, and reveal dependencies. It may not fabricate demand, willingness to pay, legal clearance, partner commitment, cost certainty, or decision authority. - Separate current observations from forecasts, assumptions, and recommended choices. - Show the evidence and sensitivity behind market size, cost, capacity, revenue, adoption, and timeline estimates.
evidence_requirements: Current traceable market, customer, cost, capacity, competitor, regulatory, and partner evidence.
Source and method for every material estimate or forecast.
failure_anti_patterns: Strategy as goals, slogans, forecasts, or feature lists without choices and exclusions.
Fictional market demand, customer commitment, willingness to pay, cost, or partner readiness.
False precision in forecasts and unit economics.
recovery: Strategic recovery contains commitments, restores truthful state, and reopens the first invalid assumption or decision.
Pause new commitments while preserving existing customer, employee, partner, legal, and safety obligations.
Identify which assumptions, evidence, incentives, capabilities, or dependencies changed or were wrong.
completion: The strategy makes explicit choices about arena, beneficiaries, value, capabilities, resources, and exclusions.
Economics, forecasts, and dependencies are bounded by traceable evidence and uncertainty.
Mission, legal, ethical, security, privacy, accessibility, and human-AI constraints are integrated.
source_gaps: This draft applies the supplied requirements for explicit objectives, source-grounded facts, uncertainty and assumption typing, consistent option comparison, human-authorized criteria, short- and long-term effects, sensitivity, reversibility, dissent, bounded roles, evidence, hostile review, and continuity. The Owner's Cockpit material adds decision support without decision seizure, trust calibration, complete owner journeys, visible limitations, and truthful status. The V4 draft adds obligation structure, resolution experiments, proof-carrying decisions, and trusted transitions.

title: Product Strategy
purpose: Define what product should exist, for whom, to produce which outcomes, under which principles and boundaries, and how evidence will guide its evolution across the lifecycle. Product strategy connects mission and business strategy to user and owner value without collapsing into a feature backlog.
why_it_matters: Without product strategy, feature requests, competitor imitation, model capabilities, and internal convenience become the de facto product direction. The result may function technically while failing the user's actual job, the owner's control needs, or the mission.
applies_when: A product or product family must choose users, problems, capabilities, positioning, or lifecycle direction.
Multiple feature, platform, AI, design, or operational options compete for investment.
does_not_apply_when: A bounded implementation task inherits a current approved product strategy and changes no product outcome or principle.
Evidence of users, problems, or context is inadequate; user and market research must precede strategic commitment.
prerequisites: Mission and business strategy sufficient to define product purpose and constraints.
Research, market, competitor, stakeholder, user, domain, feasibility, and risk evidence proportional to the decision.
An authorized product decision owner and explicit prioritization criteria.
required_inputs: Mission outcomes, business choices, user jobs, pain, context, accessibility needs, and recovery expectations.
Market structure, alternatives, differentiation evidence, and changing conditions.
Current product behavior, usage, support findings, incidents, reliability, security, privacy, and operational cost.
human_authority: The human product owner decides whom the product serves, what outcomes matter, which tradeoffs are acceptable, and how much authority may be delegated to product mechanisms or AI. - Confirm intended users, owner roles, excluded contexts, product outcomes, and non-goals. - Authorize product principles and prioritization criteria.
ai_boundary: The AI may synthesize evidence, identify patterns, generate alternatives, and maintain traceability. It may not invent users, needs, consent, demand, priorities, or product acceptance. - Separate user evidence from internal requests, model suggestions, market assumptions, and competitor imitation. - Translate outcomes into capability hypotheses without prematurely specifying features or architecture.
evidence_requirements: Traceable user, owner, market, domain, support, incident, and operational evidence.
Current capability evidence bound to artifact, version, environment, provider, and limitations.
failure_anti_patterns: Feature factory behavior disconnected from user outcomes or mission.
Invented personas, demand, user needs, acceptance, or accessibility claims.
Copying competitors without context or problem evidence.
recovery: Product-strategy recovery returns the product to evidence, user outcomes, mission, and legitimate authority after drift or invalid assumptions.
Pause affected roadmap or release commitments while preserving safe service and user obligations.
Identify which problem, capability, user, provider, outcome, or business assumption failed.
completion: Users, owners, contexts, problems, outcomes, non-goals, and product authority are explicit.
Capabilities and roadmap logic are evidence-grounded and distinct from features or promises.
Product principles cover agency, trust, accessibility, privacy, security, safety, reliability, recovery, and lifecycle.
source_gaps: This draft applies the supplied requirements for owner jobs and complete journeys, objective fidelity, evidence-before-claims, current-state inspection, capability-versus-authority separation, bounded delegation, grounded dialogue, visible uncertainty, accessibility, security, privacy, recovery, continuity, and no fake success. The role corpus supplies user-experience review, research, analysis, architecture, planning, testing, verification, governance, and hostile review. V4 adds claim and obligation structure, minimum-resolution experiments, proof-carrying results, dissent, and trusted transition.

title: Portfolio Management
purpose: Govern a collection of products, programs, projects, experiments, capabilities, investments, and retirements as one constrained decision system. Portfolio management determines what should start, continue, pause, merge, split, reduce, transfer, or end.
why_it_matters: Individually reasonable initiatives can collectively exceed capacity, duplicate infrastructure, create contradictory commitments, concentrate risk, or compete for the same human authority. Without a portfolio view, local success can produce systemic failure. AI can rank hundreds of initiatives, but a score cannot legitimately decide human priorities, protected obligations, or acceptable concentration of risk.
applies_when: More than one initiative competes for shared resources, platforms, data, customers, operators, or authority.
The organization must balance exploration, delivery, maintenance, compliance, resilience, and retirement.
does_not_apply_when: Only one bounded initiative exists and it does not share material resources or dependencies.
The task is simple reporting with no authority to prioritize or change portfolio state.
prerequisites: Mission, business, and product strategy sufficient to establish portfolio criteria and protected obligations.
Stable inventory of initiatives and lifecycle states.
Authenticated portfolio decision authority and escalation paths.
required_inputs: Initiative charters, objectives, owners, scope, outcomes, costs, schedules, risks, and current evidence.
Resource and capacity data for people, agents, budget, infrastructure, environments, data, and attention.
Shared architecture, platform, vendor, model, security, compliance, and operational dependencies.
human_authority: The authorized portfolio owner retains final authority over resource allocation, initiation, continuation, and termination, especially where choices encode values or affect people. - Authorize portfolio criteria, weighting, capacity boundaries, and mandatory constraints. - Decide tradeoffs among mission, growth, reliability, maintenance, safety, compliance, exploration, and retirement.
ai_boundary: The AI may normalize information, expose dependencies, model scenarios, and recommend portfolio actions. It may not create resources, invent comparability, or turn a ranking into authority. - Preserve each initiative's objective, source evidence, state, uncertainty, and owner. - Flag missing or stale information before comparison. - Separate mandatory eligibility constraints from weighted preferences.
evidence_requirements: Current initiative state and outcome evidence from authoritative records.
Resource availability and cost evidence, including uncertainty and time bounds.
failure_anti_patterns: Scoring theater that converts weak or incomparable data into a single authoritative rank.
Overcommitment based on hypothetical people, agents, budget, or infrastructure.
Hidden shared dependencies and correlated failure risk.
recovery: Portfolio recovery restores a truthful inventory, contains systemic risk, and rebalances commitments within real capacity.
Freeze affected initiation or allocation decisions while preserving critical obligations.
Reconcile initiative identities, states, evidence, dependencies, resources, and commitments.
completion: Every in-scope initiative has a stable identity, owner, state, evidence, dependencies, and next decision.
Criteria, mandatory constraints, capacity, and resource assumptions are explicit.
Shared risks, concentration, obligations, and lifecycle balance are visible.
source_gaps: This draft applies the supplied requirements for explicit objective and authority, consistent option evaluation, mandatory constraints, sensitivity and reversibility, bounded planning, dependency classification, observable states, evidence-backed completion, role coordination, conflict transparency, human final authority, and continuity. It also uses the V4 concepts of obligation lattices, claim typing, proof-carrying transitions, and trusted advancement that cannot outrun evidence.

title: Program Management
purpose: Coordinate multiple related projects, products, workstreams, and organizational changes so they collectively produce an authorized outcome that no single project can deliver alone. Program management governs shared outcomes, benefits, dependencies, interfaces, resources, risks, decisions, and transitions across workstreams.
why_it_matters: Projects can each satisfy their local scope while the program fails because interfaces, timing, adoption, operations, data, authority, or benefits were never integrated. Conversely, a program office can create fictional progress by aggregating activities and suppressing project-level failure or dissent. Multi-agent execution magnifies this risk. Parallel agents can produce more output while fragmenting truth.
applies_when: The desired outcome requires multiple interdependent projects, products, teams, vendors, agents, or organizational changes.
Shared architecture, data, platforms, environments, releases, customers, or operations create cross-project risk.
does_not_apply_when: A single project can deliver and validate the complete outcome without material external dependencies.
The work is a loose portfolio of unrelated initiatives with no shared program outcome.
prerequisites: An approved mission, strategy, portfolio decision, and defined program outcome.
Authenticated sponsor, program owner, workstream owners, decision rights, and escalation paths.
Known projects or workstreams, dependencies, commitments, constraints, and current states.
required_inputs: Program objective, outcomes, benefits, scope, exclusions, constraints, and success evidence.
Project and product charters, roadmaps, plans, architecture, requirements, risks, and current status.
Stakeholder, user, organizational, vendor, regulatory, security, privacy, safety, and operational obligations.
human_authority: The sponsor and authorized program owner retain authority over program outcomes, resource commitments, scope changes, cross-workstream tradeoffs, and acceptance of residual risk. - Ratify the program charter, governance, workstream boundaries, decision rights, and escalation thresholds. - Approve program-level scope, funding, capacity, vendor, release, migration, and operational commitments.
ai_boundary: The AI may coordinate, analyze dependencies, maintain state, and surface conflicts only within recorded authority. It may not invent program scope, owners, resources, approvals, or completion. - Preserve the actual program outcome and each workstream's bounded objective. - Maintain stable identities and exact versions for deliverables, dependencies, decisions, and evidence.
evidence_requirements: Current workstream state and artifact identity from authoritative records.
Evidence for dependencies, resource availability, interfaces, and shared constraints.
failure_anti_patterns: Program as reporting layer with no authority, integration, or outcome responsibility.
Green program status built from incomplete, blocked, failed, or unverified project reports.
Hidden dependencies, version mismatch, duplicated work, and ambiguous ownership.
recovery: Program recovery isolates affected workstreams, restores authoritative state, and reestablishes a safe integrated path.
Enter a bounded hold or safe halt for affected integrations while preserving unaffected safe work.
Reconcile artifact versions, workstream states, dependencies, decisions, resources, and evidence.
completion: The program outcome, workstreams, owners, authority, dependencies, and completion evidence are explicit.
Shared governance and architecture are defined without erasing bounded responsibilities.
Integrated behavior, operational transition, and complete journeys have current evidence.
source_gaps: This draft applies the supplied Planner and Coordinator contracts for bounded work, dependency classification, workstream assignment, parallelization, conflict handling, evidence, validation gates, human decisions, and continuity. It applies the Owner's Cockpit requirements for durable multi-agent handoffs, exact upstream artifact identity, one authoritative status source, visible conflicts, governed action, and owner control. title: Project Management
purpose: Convert an authorized, bounded objective into a controlled temporary endeavor that produces defined deliverables and verified outcomes under explicit scope, resources, dependencies, risks, quality, and acceptance conditions. Project management in Thirsty's Codex is not status theater or calendar maintenance.
why_it_matters: Projects fail when a plausible plan is treated as reality, activity is treated as outcome, or delivery is treated as acceptance. AI can make these failures look unusually polished by generating complete-looking schedules, task lists, and reports from incomplete inputs. Governed project management keeps the project tied to actual authority, dependencies, available resources, evidence, and acceptance.
applies_when: A temporary, bounded body of work must create, change, migrate, validate, or retire a defined result.
Work requires sequencing, resource coordination, dependencies, milestones, risk, and acceptance.
does_not_apply_when: The work is a single trivial task that can be safely completed under an existing task envelope.
The work is ongoing product or operational management rather than a temporary endeavor.
prerequisites: An approved objective from strategy, portfolio, program, product, remediation, migration, incident, or lifecycle governance.
Authenticated sponsor, project owner, decision rights, escalation, and acceptance authority.
Sufficient requirements, constraints, current-state evidence, and target-state definition.
required_inputs: Objective, scope, exclusions, deliverables, acceptance criteria, and desired operating outcome.
Current repository, system, process, product, data, infrastructure, or physical state.
Requirements, architecture, design, quality, security, privacy, safety, accessibility, and compliance obligations.
human_authority: The sponsor and project owner establish legitimacy, priorities, resources, and acceptance. Project coordination does not create authority beyond that grant. - Approve the charter, scope, exclusions, deliverables, constraints, and acceptance authority. - Provide or authorize real resource commitments and resolve unavailable-resource conflicts.
ai_boundary: The AI may plan, coordinate, track, analyze, and report only from current evidence and delegated authority. It may not invent owners, personnel, dates, approvals, dependencies, status, or completion. - Restate the approved objective and declared mode before decomposing work. - Identify current state and hard dependencies before scheduling implementation.
evidence_requirements: Authenticated charter and human approvals.
Current artifact, environment, dependency, resource, and configuration evidence.
failure_anti_patterns: Project plan generated before objective, current state, authority, or requirements are known.
Invented dates, resources, approvals, dependencies, budgets, or confidence.
Activity milestones such as 'work ongoing' instead of observable state.
recovery: Project recovery reestablishes the last known truthful state, contains consequence, and replans from verified conditions.
Pause affected work and preserve artifacts, logs, branches, environments, evidence, and in-flight state.
Reconcile planned state with actual repository, system, resource, and dependency state.
completion: The project objective, scope, authority, deliverables, owners, and acceptance are explicit.
Tasks, dependencies, resources, risks, changes, and evidence are current and traceable.
All required deliverables exist and have the declared test, verification, and acceptance state.
source_gaps: This draft directly applies the supplied Planner and Coordinator role contracts, including objective preservation, task definition, dependency classification, observable milestones, estimation discipline, risk, blockers, change control, validation gates, completion evidence, assignment contracts, conflict transparency, and human authority. Assign bounded roles without converting expertise into authority.

title: Product Management
purpose: Continuously govern product decisions from discovery through delivery, operation, learning, change, deprecation, and retirement so the product remains aligned with mission, strategy, user outcomes, evidence, and real system capability. Product management is an ongoing decision function, not backlog administration.
why_it_matters: A product can drift when the backlog becomes the strategy, the loudest request becomes the priority, or shipping becomes the only definition of progress. AI can accelerate intake and synthesis while also amplifying noise, duplicating requests, inventing demand, and making weak priorities look quantitative.
applies_when: A product is being discovered, built, operated, changed, supported, monetized, deprecated, or retired.
Requests, problems, opportunities, defects, incidents, risks, or strategic bets compete for prioritization.
does_not_apply_when: A bounded project or maintenance task creates no product decision and follows an approved product plan.
The work is portfolio-level resource allocation rather than product-level outcome governance.
prerequisites: Approved product strategy and product decision owner.
Research, market, stakeholder, user, domain, feasibility, risk, and business analysis appropriate to the decision.
Current product, architecture, roadmap, requirement, release, support, incident, analytics, and operational state.
required_inputs: Product strategy, mission, business constraints, product principles, and intended outcomes.
User research, feedback, usability, accessibility, support, incident, and behavioral evidence.
Market, competitive, stakeholder, regulatory, legal, security, privacy, safety, and ethical evidence.
human_authority: The product owner retains authority over priorities, promises, tradeoffs, releases, deprecation, and retirement within higher governance. AI may assist but may not create product legitimacy. - Confirm product outcomes, principles, prioritization criteria, and mandatory constraints. - Decide tradeoffs among users, stakeholders, mission, business, risk, accessibility, privacy, safety, and operations.
ai_boundary: The AI may classify, link, summarize, compare, forecast, and recommend from current evidence. It may not fabricate users, demand, priority, acceptance, or completed product state. - Preserve source identity and distinguish requests, observations, hypotheses, commitments, and verified outcomes. - Deduplicate without erasing materially different contexts, users, or consequences.
evidence_requirements: Source and context for every material request, finding, commitment, and decision.
User, market, domain, support, incident, analytics, operational, and technical evidence with dates and limitations.
failure_anti_patterns: Backlog as strategy and feature count as progress.
Prioritization by requester volume, hierarchy, revenue, engagement, or model confidence alone.
Invented user demand, acceptance, urgency, or impact.
recovery: Product-management recovery restores truthful product state and reopens decisions whose evidence, dependencies, or commitments became invalid.
Pause affected commitments or rollout while preserving safe service and user obligations.
Reconcile authoritative product, roadmap, capability, release, support, incident, and evidence state.
completion: The product decision system has an authorized owner, current evidence, and explicit criteria.
Intake, prioritization, roadmap, requirements, release, outcomes, and lifecycle are traceable.
Product and AI capability states are truthful and version-bound.
source_gaps: This draft applies the supplied owner-job, journey, trust-calibration, grounded-dialogue, capability-state, evidence, release, rollback, feedback, and lifecycle principles from the Owner's Cockpit; the role corpus adds research, analysis, planning, coordination, observation, UX review, testing, verification, governance, and hostile review; V3 and V4 add objective fidelity, no fake success, claim and obligation structure, evidence contracts, human authority, and proof-carrying transition.

Unresolved source gap: the supplied corpus does not contain a dedicated universal product-management, prioritization, discovery, or roadmap standard. Quantitative prioritization methods and product analytics must later be reconciled with Operations Research, Product Analytics, Experimentation, Feedback Management, Roadmap Management, and lifecycle sections.

Recognize a near-match where it should not govern.
Assign bounded roles without converting expertise into authority.
Determine what evidence/state is sufficient for the next transition and when to defer/suspend/request evidence.

title: Business Analysis
purpose: Establish a precise, evidence-grounded understanding of organizational needs, current and target states, actors, capabilities, processes, information, rules, decisions, constraints, and gaps before those needs are converted into requirements, architecture, or implementation.
why_it_matters: A request often arrives in solution language: build a dashboard, add AI, automate approval, migrate to the cloud. If the underlying need, rule, authority, or failure is not established, the system may implement the request perfectly and still make the organization less capable or less safe. Business analysis prevents requirements from becoming a transcript of assumptions.
applies_when: A strategic, product, program, project, process, policy, or system change must be understood before design.
Stakeholder statements conflict or use ambiguous business and domain terminology.
does_not_apply_when: The need, rules, current state, target state, and requirements are already authoritative, current, and unaffected by the task.
The assignment is a bounded implementation or verification action with no business interpretation.
prerequisites: An authorized objective, analysis question, scope, decision owner, and intended downstream use.
Relevant research, strategy, stakeholder, user, market, domain, and current-state sources.
Access to authoritative policies, procedures, records, systems, data definitions, roles, and operational evidence.
required_inputs: Mission, strategy, product, program, project, policy, and governance documents.
Stakeholder and user needs, jobs, journeys, pain, workarounds, decisions, and recovery behavior.
Current processes, roles, capabilities, systems, data, reports, controls, incidents, and performance evidence.
human_authority: The authorized human confirms organizational intent, policy, values, decision rights, and acceptable change. The analyst does not become the business owner. - Define the decision or change the analysis must support. - Identify authoritative owners for processes, rules, data, policy, and target outcomes. - Correct terminology, undocumented practice, exception handling, and political or cultural context.
ai_boundary: The AI may structure, compare, model, and expose gaps. It may not invent business rules, authority, stakeholder consensus, data meaning, policy, or target-state approval. - Preserve source wording and distinguish stated need, observed practice, inferred rule, policy, recommendation, and approved requirement.
evidence_requirements: Authoritative source identity, owner, version, date, jurisdiction, and applicability.
Observed workflow, system, data, incident, performance, and exception evidence.
failure_anti_patterns: Solution-first analysis that merely justifies a preselected technology.
Stakeholder statements treated as facts, policy, consensus, or requirements without validation.
Business rules invented from current software behavior or AI inference.
recovery: Business-analysis recovery returns to authoritative need, source, and actual current state when models or conclusions prove wrong.
Pause dependent requirement or design decisions affected by the invalid analysis.
Identify which source, term, observation, rule, process, assumption, or authority was wrong or changed.
completion: The analysis question, scope, owner, sources, and affected parties are explicit.
Current and target states, needs, capabilities, processes, rules, information, decisions, and gaps are traceable.
Facts, observations, inferences, assumptions, recommendations, and approvals remain distinct.
source_gaps: This draft applies the supplied Researcher and Analyst disciplines for exact questions, source quality, definitions, current baselines, consistent comparison, alternative explanations, uncertainty, and advisory recommendations. It applies the Architect's requirement for responsibilities, interfaces, authority flows, trust boundaries, failure modes, and open decisions; the Owner's Cockpit adds owner jobs, language, journeys, evidence, recovery, and decision support without seizure; V3 and V4 add objective fidelity, claim typing, obligation mapping, evidence, dissent, and continuity.

Unresolved source gap: the supplied corpus does not mandate a particular business-analysis notation or methodology. BPMN, decision models, capability maps, value streams, use cases, and other techniques must be selected based on context and later reconciled with Domain Analysis, Requirements Engineering, Process Architecture, Data Modeling, and Policy.

Recognize a near-match where it should not govern.
Assign bounded roles without converting expertise into authority.
Determine what evidence/state is sufficient for the next transition and when to defer/suspend/request evidence.

title: Market Research
purpose: Establish a truthful, current, and methodologically bounded understanding of external demand, populations, segments, behaviors, alternatives, channels, pricing or funding conditions, adoption barriers, and market structure for a specific decision. Market research does not manufacture a market narrative.
why_it_matters: Market claims are unusually easy to inflate. Search snippets, vendor forecasts, social media activity, synthetic respondents, and model-generated summaries can create the appearance of broad demand without representative evidence. Governed market research prevents strategic commitments from resting on fictional populations or stale categories.
applies_when: A business, product, portfolio, investment, market-entry, pricing, channel, or positioning decision depends on external evidence.
The size, characteristics, needs, behavior, willingness, adoption, or constraints of a population are uncertain.
does_not_apply_when: The question concerns a single known user's workflow and belongs to User Research.
The question concerns internal processes and belongs to Business Analysis.
prerequisites: An authorized decision question, population, scope, horizon, criteria, and research owner.
Definitions for market, category, customer, user, buyer, beneficiary, competitor, substitute, adoption, and demand as applicable.
Privacy, consent, accessibility, security, legal, licensing, and jurisdictional review for collection and use.
required_inputs: Mission, business, product, portfolio, pricing, channel, and investment questions.
Existing market studies, primary data, public records, industry sources, surveys, interviews, observations, transactions, support, and product evidence.
Population and segment definitions, geographies, jurisdictions, languages, accessibility needs, and time windows.
human_authority: The human research owner defines the decision, acceptable method, protected populations, budget, and whether evidence is sufficient for commitment. - Approve the question, population, method, participant protections, and use of findings. - Resolve value choices about inclusion, segmentation, acceptable uncertainty, and affected populations.
ai_boundary: The AI may search authorized sources, structure data, analyze patterns, and propose interpretations. It may not fabricate participants, responses, citations, sample representativeness, demand, market size, or willingness to pay. - Record exact sources, dates, versions, methods, populations, and access boundaries. - Separate primary from secondary evidence and observed behavior from stated intent.
evidence_requirements: Exact source identity, date, version, publisher, methodology, population, sponsor, and limitations.
Sampling frame, recruitment, sample size, inclusion, exclusion, nonresponse, weighting, and missing-data records.
failure_anti_patterns: Market-size theater using undefined categories and vendor forecasts.
Search snippets, social activity, model output, or source count treated as demand evidence.
Synthetic respondents, fabricated quotations, or invented surveys.
recovery: Market-research recovery withdraws unsupported claims, protects participants, and rebuilds the evidence chain from the first invalid source or method.
Stop use of affected data or conclusions and preserve evidence of the defect.
Contain privacy, consent, security, or licensing incidents and follow required notification or deletion procedures.
completion: The decision question, population, method, sources, sample, timeframe, and authority are explicit.
Data collection and use satisfy consent, privacy, security, accessibility, legal, and licensing requirements.
Findings are traceable and bounded by sample, method, geography, jurisdiction, and time.
source_gaps: This draft applies the supplied Researcher discipline for primary sources, dates, versions, source authority, conflicting evidence, terminology, uncertainty, and traceable citations; the Analyst discipline adds baselines, sampling limitations, alternative explanations, sensitivity, and proportionate conclusions; the Observer role adds provenance, uncertainty, absence-versus-nonobservation, privacy, and integrity; V3, the Owner's Cockpit, and V4 add consent, data protection, evidence, human authority, and continuity.

Unresolved source gap: the supplied corpus does not contain a dedicated survey, sampling, econometric, market-sizing, or pricing-research standard. Methods must later be reconciled with Statistics, Data Science, Experimentation, Privacy Engineering, Legal, Regulatory Compliance, and Financial Operations.

Recognize a near-match where it should not govern.
Assign bounded roles without converting expertise into authority.
Determine what evidence/state is sufficient for the next transition and when to defer/suspend/request evidence.

title: Competitive Intelligence
purpose: Produce lawful, ethical, current, and decision-relevant understanding of competitors, substitutes, adjacent actors, ecosystem forces, and alternative approaches without misrepresenting public claims as verified capability or crossing security, privacy, contractual, or trade-secret boundaries. Competitive intelligence supports strategy by revealing differences, dependencies, likely responses, and evidence gaps.
why_it_matters: Competitive decisions are often made from websites, demos, press releases, analyst reports, rumors, and benchmark claims that describe different versions, environments, or criteria. AI can aggregate these sources quickly while also blending marketing language with inference and reproducing unverified claims as fact. Governed intelligence protects strategy from both complacency and reactive imitation.
applies_when: Strategy, positioning, product, partnership, procurement, investment, pricing, or risk decisions depend on external actors or alternatives.
A competitor or substitute may materially change user expectations, market structure, technology, regulation, supply, or security.
does_not_apply_when: The purpose is covert access, impersonation, social engineering, unauthorized testing, theft, or acquisition of protected information.
The decision can be made from user, mission, and feasibility evidence without competitor analysis.
prerequisites: An authorized intelligence question, decision owner, collection boundary, jurisdiction, and prohibited methods.
Mission, product, business, or procurement criteria defining why the comparison matters.
A source hierarchy and evidence-state model.
required_inputs: Public filings, official documentation, product pages, terms, pricing, release notes, standards, repositories, demonstrations, support materials, and published research.
Independent tests, reviews, customer evidence, incidents, legal actions, procurement evidence, and technical analysis where lawfully available.
Competitor, substitute, ecosystem, provider, partner, and channel definitions.
human_authority: The authorized human defines legitimate targets, collection methods, comparison criteria, and strategic response. Competitive pressure does not create permission. - Approve the intelligence question, subjects, methods, source use, and legal or ethical boundaries. - Define which differences matter to mission, users, business, risk, or procurement.
ai_boundary: The AI may collect authorized public information, normalize evidence, compare, and monitor. It may not impersonate, infiltrate, solicit secrets, bypass controls, fabricate sources, or present inference as observed competitor fact. - Record exact source, publisher, date, version, product tier, environment, jurisdiction, and access method.
evidence_requirements: Exact source, publisher, date, version, tier, configuration, environment, and access method.
Evidence state for every competitor and internal capability claim.
failure_anti_patterns: Espionage, impersonation, unauthorized access, social engineering, or solicitation of protected information.
Marketing pages, demos, rumors, or analyst summaries treated as verified capability.
Apples-to-oranges comparison across tier, version, configuration, population, or environment.
recovery: Competitive-intelligence recovery withdraws invalid findings, contains legal or security exposure, and restores the source boundary.
Stop affected collection or use and preserve evidence of the defect.
Contain and report any unauthorized access, privacy, confidentiality, licensing, or security incident.
completion: The question, subjects, methods, authority, criteria, timeframe, and prohibited actions are explicit.
Sources are lawful, examined, current, and traceable.
Claims, documentation, demonstrations, independent tests, inferences, and unknowns remain distinct.
source_gaps: This draft applies the supplied Researcher requirements for primary sources, exact disagreement, dates, versions, terminology, and no invented citations; the Analyst requirements for consistent criteria, alternatives, uncertainty, sensitivity, and advisory conclusions; the Security Auditor and Red Team boundaries for lawful access and hostile review; V3 and V4 add source identity, objective fidelity, evidence, human authority, and continuity.

Unresolved source gap: the supplied corpus does not contain a dedicated competitive-intelligence legal standard or jurisdiction-by-jurisdiction collection policy. Every collection program must obtain current legal and contractual review where required and later reconcile with Threat Intelligence, Legal, Intellectual Property, Licensing, Privacy, and Security Operations.
learning_objectives: Recognize when the section is materially applicable.
Recognize a near-match where it should not govern.
Assign bounded roles without converting expertise into authority.
Determine what evidence/state is sufficient for the next transition and when to defer/suspend/request evidence.

title: Stakeholder Management
purpose: Identify, understand, engage, protect, communicate with, and govern commitments to the people, groups, institutions, owners, operators, users, affected non-users, partners, regulators, communities, and other legitimate parties whose authority, interests, rights, obligations, knowledge, or exposure materially affect the work. Stakeholder management is not persuasion management.
why_it_matters: Projects often treat the most powerful or available person as the whole stakeholder set. That can erase users, operators, maintainers, accessibility needs, affected communities, and people who bear risk without holding purchasing or approval authority.
applies_when: The work affects or depends on more than the direct requester.
Approval, consent, consultation, notification, coordination, adoption, support, regulation, or public trust matters.
does_not_apply_when: A strictly private, reversible, bounded task affects only the authorized requester and creates no external obligation.
The work is demographic profiling or influence targeting without a legitimate stakeholder purpose.
prerequisites: An authorized objective, scope, decision owner, affected-system boundary, and communication authority.
Initial research and strategy sufficient to identify likely affected parties and obligations.
Privacy, consent, accessibility, security, legal, records, and retention requirements.
required_inputs: Mission, strategy, product, program, project, policy, domain, and operational context.
Known owners, users, operators, administrators, participants, communities, regulators, customers, partners, vendors, and support roles.
Authority, responsibility, accountability, consent, consultation, notification, and escalation rules.
human_authority: Humans retain authority over values, commitments, consent, risk acceptance, and relationship decisions. Stakeholder influence is not identical to decision authority. - Confirm who is materially affected, who may decide, and who must be consulted, consented, notified, or protected. - Authorize contact, data collection, representation, commitments, and communication channels.
ai_boundary: The AI may organize, translate, summarize, schedule, and support engagement within authority. It may not invent stakeholders, consent, consensus, identity, representation, emotion, commitment, or approval. - Disclose when communication is AI-generated or AI-mediated where material to trust, consent, or interpretation. - Preserve exact source, speaker, context, date, confidence, and unresolved disagreement.
evidence_requirements: Source and method for stakeholder identification and representation.
Authority, consent, consultation, notification, accessibility, and legal requirements.
failure_anti_patterns: Stakeholder list limited to sponsors, buyers, executives, or vocal users.
Manipulation, sentiment targeting, coerced consent, dark patterns, or performative consultation.
AI impersonation, fabricated empathy, invented consensus, or unauthorized commitment.
recovery: Stakeholder recovery restores truthful identity, authority, consent, commitments, and relationship state after error, harm, miscommunication, or exclusion.
Stop affected communication or action and preserve the exact record.
Correct false identity, authority, summary, translation, commitment, or consent state visibly.
completion: Material stakeholders and affected parties are identified with evidence and coverage gaps.
Roles, authority, consent, representation, impacts, obligations, and communication needs are explicit.
Engagement is accessible, lawful, noncoercive, and traceable.
source_gaps: This draft applies the supplied human-authority, bounded-delegation, owner-language, complete-journey, trust-calibration, consent, privacy, accessibility, grounded-dialogue, agent-identity, handoff, conflict, and recovery requirements. The Coordinator, Observer, Memory Curator, Teacher, User Experience Reviewer, Governance Reviewer, and Decision Arbiter Advisory contracts supply role-specific boundaries for communication, provenance, consent, dissent, and decision support. V3 and V4 add objective, scope, uncertainty, evidence, and continuity conservation.

Unresolved source gap: the supplied corpus does not contain a universal stakeholder-engagement, public-participation, labor-relations, community-consent, or future-intelligence representation standard. Those domains require current legal, ethical, cultural, and governance work and later reconciliation with User Research, Privacy, Trust and Safety, Policy, Ethics, Community Management, and Lifecycle Governance.
learning_objectives: Recognize when the section is materially applicable.
Recognize a near-match where it should not govern.
Assign bounded roles without converting expertise into authority.
Determine what evidence/state is sufficient for the next transition and when to defer/suspend/request evidence.

title: User Research
purpose: Establish a truthful understanding of the people who use, operate, own, administer, depend upon, or are materially affected by a product, service, system, process, or AI capability by examining their real goals, contexts, language, behaviors, decisions, constraints, accessibility needs, trust expectations, failure experiences, and recovery practices.
why_it_matters: A technically coherent system can still fail because it uses the wrong language, assumes the wrong mental model, hides consequence, interrupts real work, excludes disabled users, or provides no usable recovery path. When research is skipped, internal stakeholders and AI-generated narratives become substitutes for users. AI increases both the reach and the risk of user research.
applies_when: A product, service, workflow, interface, AI system, policy, or operational process is intended for or materially affects people.
User needs, jobs, language, mental models, trust, accessibility, or failure behavior are uncertain.
does_not_apply_when: The work has no human user, operator, owner, participant, subject, or materially affected party and creates no human-facing consequence.
The request is to analyze aggregate market demand rather than situated user behavior; Market Research controls that question.
prerequisites: An authorized research question, decision owner, intended downstream use, scope, and consequence level.
Section 001 Research and relevant Mission Strategy, Product Strategy, Stakeholder Management, and Business Analysis context.
Initial identification of user, owner, operator, administrator, affected non-user, and vulnerable or underrepresented groups.
required_inputs: The human's actual product, service, system, policy, or design question and the decision it will support.
Existing research, stakeholder findings, support records, incidents, analytics, complaints, accessibility findings, feedback, and prior design assumptions.
Known user roles, owner jobs, workflows, environments, devices, input methods, languages, cultures, abilities, constraints, and consequences.
human_authority: The authorized human research owner defines the legitimate question, participant protections, intended use, and decision boundary. Participants retain rights over consent, withdrawal, correction, and treatment according to the applicable context. - Approve the research question, population, method, recruitment, participant protections, and use of findings.
ai_boundary: The AI may support planning, collection, transcription, translation, coding, synthesis, and traceability only within the authorized method. It may not fabricate human evidence or silently substitute model simulation for participation. - Disclose AI involvement when it materially affects participant consent, interaction, recording, transcription, analysis, or downstream use.
evidence_requirements: Authenticated research authorization, decision purpose, method, and participant-protection approvals.
Sampling frame, recruitment path, inclusion, exclusion, compensation, participation, withdrawal, missing-group, and coverage records.
failure_anti_patterns: Invented personas, synthetic participants, fabricated quotations, or AI-generated needs presented as research.
Recruiting only easy, internal, expert, powerful, able-bodied, English-speaking, or successful users while claiming broad coverage.
Leading questions, confirmation-seeking tasks, prototype coaching, performative consultation, or sponsor-controlled interpretation.
recovery: User-research recovery protects participants, withdraws unsupported findings, and rebuilds the evidence chain from the first invalid method, consent state, source, or interpretation.
Pause affected collection, analysis, dissemination, or downstream use while preserving evidence of the issue.
Contain privacy, security, consent, coercion, accessibility, retaliation, reidentification, provider, or data-retention harm.
completion: The research question, decision, population, method, authority, participant protections, and intended use are explicit.
Actual participants and observations support every material claim; synthetic and AI-derived content remains separately classified.
Sampling, inclusion, accessibility, language, context, missing groups, bias, and generalization limits are visible.
source_gaps: This draft applies the supplied Owner's Cockpit requirements for discovery grounded in observed owner work, owner-job inventories, complete journeys, recognizable language, failure and recovery scenarios, assumption registers, participant-data protection, cognitive walkthroughs, and usability finding records. The User Experience Reviewer contract supplies intended-user and role identification without invented personas, journey mapping, accessibility, consent, evidence-backed friction, failure, and prohibited dark patterns. The Researcher, Observer, Analyst, Memory Curator, Security Auditor, Governance Reviewer, and Red Team contracts supply source discipline, observation boundaries, sampling and uncertainty limits, data minimization, consent, evidence, adversarial review, and human authority. V3 and V4 add objective fidelity, epistemic typing, bounded roles, evidence conservation, continuity, dissent, and proof-carrying handoff.

This section is therefore a Codex integration draft, not a substitute for qualified ethics, legal, accessibility, clinical, labor, educational, or regulated-research review. It must later be reconciled with UX Research, Accessibility Design, Privacy Engineering, Legal, Ethics, Statistics, Experimentation, Usability Testing, and Validation.

title: Domain Analysis
purpose: Establish a precise, shared, source-grounded model of the field in which a system or change must operate: its language, actors, responsibilities, authority, concepts, entities, values, events, states, rules, invariants, decisions, processes, exceptions, information, boundaries, dependencies, time, jurisdiction, and lifecycle.
why_it_matters: Many implementation defects are domain defects expressed in code. A term means one thing to operations and another to finance; a state transition omits a legal exception; a database record is treated as the real-world entity; an AI model recognizes a pattern but is granted authority to decide; a workflow encodes current habit as permanent policy.
applies_when: The system operates in a field with specialized terminology, rules, states, decisions, exceptions, obligations, or external authorities.
Stakeholders use conflicting or overloaded terms, or current systems encode inconsistent meanings.
does_not_apply_when: A trivial, isolated implementation uses stable, authoritative, current domain definitions and changes no meaning, rule, state, authority, or interface.
The question is purely about a user's lived experience rather than domain structure; User Research controls that inquiry, though findings may inform the domain model.
prerequisites: Section 001 Research and relevant Mission Strategy, Business Analysis, Stakeholder Management, and User Research findings.
An authorized domain question, scope, decision owner, model owner, and intended downstream use.
Access to authoritative laws, policies, standards, contracts, procedures, records, systems, experts, users, operators, incidents, and current-state evidence.
required_inputs: Mission, business, product, program, project, policy, operational, user, and stakeholder context.
Authoritative regulations, standards, contracts, policy, procedures, manuals, forms, records, datasets, schemas, APIs, events, workflows, and reports.
Domain-expert, user, owner, operator, auditor, regulator, support, incident, and exception evidence.
human_authority: Authoritative humans and institutions define legitimate domain meaning, policy, values, exceptions, and decision rights. A domain model is an accountable interpretation, not an autonomous source of truth. - Identify authoritative domain experts, owners, regulators, policy sources, data stewards, and decision authorities.
ai_boundary: The AI may extract, compare, structure, model, test, and explain domain evidence. It may not invent domain truth, policy, authority, exceptions, consensus, ontology, or legal meaning. - Preserve source identity, date, version, jurisdiction, owner, and applicability for every material domain statement.
evidence_requirements: Authoritative source identity, owner, version, date, jurisdiction, scope, integrity, and applicability for each material definition, rule, state, and decision.
Direct observation of current domain work, events, states, exceptions, decisions, artifacts, and system behavior where available.
failure_anti_patterns: Treating the existing database, API, UI, codebase, vendor product, or model vocabulary as the domain itself.
One universal model that erases bounded contexts, jurisdictions, time, organizations, or legitimate differences in meaning.
Anemic domain model containing nouns and fields but no behavior, rules, invariants, decisions, exceptions, or lifecycle.
recovery: Domain-analysis recovery identifies the first invalid meaning, rule, boundary, authority, or source and prevents that defect from propagating further through the system.
Pause dependent requirement, architecture, policy, migration, automation, or release decisions affected by the invalid domain element.
Preserve the disputed model, source versions, examples, implementation behavior, decisions, and evidence rather than rewriting history.
completion: The domain question, scope, contexts, owners, authoritative sources, jurisdictions, and downstream use are explicit.
Canonical terminology and disputed or context-specific meanings are versioned, sourced, exemplified, and governed.
Actors, identities, capabilities, permissions, responsibilities, accountability, authority, delegation, and affected parties are distinct.
source_gaps: This draft applies the supplied requirements for exact objectives, source identity, current-state inspection, terminology consistency, unknown and assumption typing, conflicting evidence, human authority, capability-versus-permission separation, architectural responsibilities, interfaces, authority flows, trust boundaries, invariants, failure and recovery, evidence, hostile review, and continuity. The Architect, Researcher, Analyst, Observer, Memory Curator, Governance Reviewer, User Experience Reviewer, Tester, Verifier, Security Auditor, Red Team, Teacher, Documentation Writer, and Decision Arbiter Advisory contracts provide the bounded role behaviors used throughout this section. The Owner's Cockpit supplies owner-recognizable language, complete journeys, grounded actions, agent identity and role, governed boundaries, authoritative state and freshness, and visible recovery. V4 supplies epistemic typing, claim graphs, obligation lattices, conservation of authority, scope, evidence, uncertainty and dissent, proof-carrying work, and artifact-consistency blocking.

Unresolved source gap: the supplied corpus does not contain a dedicated universal domain-analysis or domain-driven-design standard, formal ontology method, semantic-versioning policy for domain meaning, or industry-specific domain model. The entity, value-object, bounded-context, event, state, invariant, decision, and anti-corruption structures in this draft are general domain-analysis scaffolding and must be validated against actual source authority rather than treated as source-derived truth. This section must later be reconciled with Domain Architecture, Business Architecture, Data Modeling, Knowledge Graph Engineering, Ontology Engineering, Semantic Systems Engineering, Requirements Engineering, Policy, and the relevant industry, legal, scientific, safety, and lifecycle sections.
